caption:
Koko spent hours walking and standing at the shopping centre, and now her feet throb every time she gets home.

Long stretches on hard floors can tire your feet out, especially in thin-soled shoes. Cushioned, well-fitted shoes and regular sit-down breaks may help your feet cope with a big day out.

Hybi's tip: sit down for a break every hour, then at home stretch your calves for 30 seconds twice and gently roll your foot over a ball.

Trouble putting weight on your foot, swelling or warmth, or heel pain with your first steps each morning are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
